unlisted_practices: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation integrating time-sensitive clinical guidelines into LLM treatment planning
Domain adaptation of LLMs via large-scale clinical text pre-training, model merging, post-training, and agent-based reinforcement learning
Blind randomized oncologist evaluation comparing LLM treatment plans with oncologist-written plans

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a new agentic LLM (GatorOnco) for colorectal cancer treatment planning using clinician expert evaluation on simulated/retrospective cases, but evaluates the system overall rather than isolating a deployment practice or guardrail.
